rendered: The separated cathode powder was calcined in air at 600 °C[1] for 2 h[2]. The stated purpose was to remove the surface coating and the carbon black (CB) conductive additive. The TGA-DTG data show the organic coating layer losing ~3.3 wt% loss at ~350 °C[3] and CB losing ~4.1 wt% loss at ~550 °C[4], so both can be removed by calcining in air at 600 °C[5]. SEM images after calcination confirm the removal of the coating layer and the elimination of CB.
